brief.headline: Blackstone records $6bn in European private equity exits
bullets: Exits & Secondaries: Blackstone has generated approximately $6bn in proceeds from European private equity exits so far in 2026, more than double its previous annual record set in 2014, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Insurance & Retirement: HedgeCo Networks reports: Blackstone Credit & Insurance Led a $1 Billion Private Financing for the Combination of Analogic and Leidos’ Security Businesses.
Earnings & AUM: Fund-management giant BlackRock said Wednesday that assets under management are nearly $15.5 trillion after growth of 15%.
Investor Outlook: Chinese exports are surging worldwide—and particularly in emerging markets, says Trina Chen, co-head of Greater China Equity Research.
AI & Technology: On Inside Blackstone, host Christine Anderson sits down with SoftBank founder and CEO Masayoshi “Masa” Son.
brief.marketRead: The S&P 500 stands at 7,805.45 (roughly unchanged on the prior reading) and the VIX is 15.3, a normal-volatility reading.
